create_application_config: create an ApplicationConfig with title, width, height, and external timer settings for a PyQt window
run_application_plot: run the Application node to launch a PyQt window with configured plots and an optional external timer
setup_application_window: setup a pyqt GraphicsWindow with a title, dimensions, and add plot items in a vertical layout
update_application_plots: update all plot nodes in the Application by calling their update methods on each timer tick
cleanup_application: cleanup and quit the PyQt application by calling the cleanup method on the Application node
